finish_message: Phase 2 PDF reader and excerpt engine implementation is complete and pushed.
summary: Added media storage, PDF loading/MD5/outline/thumbnail/cropping, excerpt-to-card coordination, a PDFKit-backed SwiftUI reader with text and marquee selection, card overlays and jump navigation, app integration for opening PDFs and browsing excerpts, and PDF-focused unit tests.
notes: The implementation targets macOS PDFKit/AppKit/SwiftUI. The available execution environment here does not provide the macOS SDK, so swift test and swift build were not run locally; the orchestrator should run both validation commands on macOS.
